name: Layers 13th Month Pay Calculator – Philippines
author: sumoffice

sections.description:
Give clients and employees a working 13th-month pay calculation on your own website. Add one block or shortcode. The visitor enters the basic salary earned during the year and the workbook recalculates in the page — no spreadsheet download and no sign-in required.

This focused plugin is for Philippine accounting firms, payroll providers, HR consultants, employers and salary-information publishers preparing for the year-end payment season. Department of Labor and Employment guidance says covered private-sector employers must pay 13th-month pay no later than December 24. The minimum is generally one-twelfth of total basic salary earned during the calendar year. The workbook helps with the arithmetic; it is not legal, tax or payroll advice.

What the visitor gets

  • A live workbook embedded directly in the page.
  • Editable input cells and formulas that update immediately.
  • Their own browser copy; one visitor never sees another visitor’s figures.
  • Print and download actions provided by the Layers document frame.
  • A responsive frame with automatic height.
  • No Layers account required to calculate.

Add it in two ways

Block editor: insert the “13th Month Pay Calculator” block. The live preview appears in the editor and on the page.

Shortcode: use [layers_13th_month] in the classic editor, a widget or any page builder that supports shortcodes. Optional height: [layers_13th_month height="1000"].

Attribution and the optional 30% affiliate share

Every frame includes an anonymous channel mark in the form from=wp-13th-<your-domain>. It lets Layers count opens and starts for this plugin without sending visitor contact details to the website owner.

If you have a Layers affiliate code, enter it in Settings → 13th Month Pay Calculator. The plugin adds that eight-character code to the frame as ref. If one of those visitors later becomes a paying Layers customer, the affiliate receives 30% of that payment under the Layers affiliate program. The affiliate does not receive the visitor’s name, email, workbook or other contact details.

The plugin does not add a separate public “Powered by” credit link.

External services

This plugin embeds a calculator served by Layers (https://layers.md), an online office suite.

  • What is loaded and when: a page containing the block or shortcode loads a frame from https://app.layers.md/t/13th-month-pay-computation-2026 when the visitor scrolls near it. Editing, recalculation, printing and downloading happen through that service.
  • What is sent: the fixed calculator slug, a site mark (from=wp-13th-<your-domain>), the optional eight-character affiliate code (ref), and the standard request data of any web page (IP address, browser user agent and referring page).
  • What is not sent to the website owner: the plugin does not provide visitor names, email addresses, phone numbers or workbook contents to the website owner.

Layers terms of use: https://layers.md/userAgreement — privacy policy: https://layers.md/privacyPolicy

Official reference: Department of Labor and Employment / Bureau of Working Conditions, “13th-Month Pay Not Later Than December 24”: https://bwc.dole.gov.ph/dole-bwc-urges-employers-to-release-13th-month-pay-not-later-than-december-24/
sections.installation:
1. Install from Plugins → Add New, or upload the plugin zip and activate it.
  2. Add the “13th Month Pay Calculator” block to a page, or paste [layers_13th_month].
  3. Optional: open Settings → 13th Month Pay Calculator to set the height or enter your Layers affiliate code.
sections.faq:
When is 13th-month pay due in the Philippines?

Department of Labor and Employment guidance says it must be paid no later than December 24 for covered private-sector employees. Check the current DOLE guidance and obtain professional advice for your situation.

How is 13th-month pay calculated?

The general minimum formula is total basic salary earned during the calendar year divided by 12. The workbook calculates that amount from the figures entered. Employment status, components of basic salary, company policy and current guidance can affect a real payroll result.

Does the calculator collect visitor contacts?

No. The plugin does not ask for or send visitor names, email addresses or phone numbers to the website owner.

Do visitors need a Layers account?

No. They can enter figures, calculate, print and download without signing in. Saving a long-lived copy to Layers is optional.

Can I use it with Elementor or another page builder?

Yes. Use the builder’s Shortcode widget and paste [layers_13th_month].

Is this legal or payroll advice?

No. It is a calculation aid. Verify the inputs and current legal, tax and payroll treatment with DOLE guidance and a qualified professional.
